# Kinetic typography for Claude Code — 17 type pieces in HyperFrames

**A word, line or manifesto becomes one of 17 beat-timed typography pieces, from one-word slams to a word corridor tunnel.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_9f9aa09abad7.webp" alt="Kinetic type cuts on the beat: one word strobing through typefaces, big red and white word slams, then a word corridor rushing toward the camera." width="480"></p>

Seventeen art-directed kinetic typography templates with exact presets: typeface strobe (one word through nine faces), one-word-per-beat slams, word corridor tunnel, perspective photo wall, type specimen grid, justified manifesto, Didone city title, scanned-sheet glitch wordmark, hyphen bridge wordmark, CRT decrypt, particle burst, anime command screen, photocopy explainer, echo stack over a halftone portrait, glyph-tracking terminal camera, bitten word and liquid art reveal. Presets cover beat maths (frames per beat), letter-spacing, free font pairings for Didone, condensed, grotesk and mono looks, riso and paper palettes in hex, 3D camera values and seeded glitch timing, from Art of the Title, Practical Typography, Fonts In Use and motion designers on X. Use when someone wants a kinetic type intro, a manifesto or lyric-style type piece, a wordmark animation or a typographic poster in motion. NOT for subtitles (caption-styles) or broadcast lower thirds (title-design).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill kinetic-type-art                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills kinetic-type-art --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 73 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

## Ask your agent

- "Make a 15-second kinetic type intro, one word per beat at 120 BPM: BUILD. SHIP. REPEAT."
- "Animate the manifesto in ./manifesto.txt as a justified column with photos opening in the gaps"
- "Typeface strobe on the word NOW that lands on our brand font, 9:16"
